data.name: TuningViewText45
data.value: Advanced performance tuning • Undervolt • Overclock • Power Limits

data.name: TuningViewText168
data.value: Reset live tuning where available and normalize startup tuning state to safe Balanced/Auto defaults.

data.name: TuningViewText199
data.value: CPU undervolt is not available on this machine

data.name: TuningViewText416
data.value: Apply the CPU voltage offset above. An offset that is too aggressive can cause instability or crashes — test gradually.

data.name: TuningViewText423
data.value: Remove the CPU voltage offset, returning the CPU to its stock voltage.

data.name: TuningViewText433
data.value: Adjust CPU sustained (PL1) and burst (PL2) power limits. Higher values = more performance but more heat.

data.name: TuningViewText477
data.value: Re-read the current CPU power limits from the hardware.

data.name: TuningViewText614
data.value: Apply the CPU PL1/PL2 power limits above. Higher limits allow more sustained performance but more heat.

data.name: TuningViewText622
data.value: Restore the CPU power limits to this model's stock values.

data.name: TuningViewText632
data.value: Control AMD Ryzen STAPM power and Tctl temperature limits via SMU.

data.name: TuningViewText762
data.value: Read the four power limits back out of the SMU. Does not write anything.

data.name: TuningViewText768
data.value: Apply the AMD STAPM/temperature limits above.

data.name: TuningViewText774
data.value: Restore the AMD CPU power limits to this model's stock values.

data.name: TuningViewText884
data.value: Apply the CPU thermal throttle limit above. The CPU will begin throttling at this temperature instead of its stock limit.

data.name: TuningViewText891
data.value: Remove the thermal throttle limit, returning the CPU to its stock throttle temperature.

data.name: TuningViewText912
data.value: What the NVIDIA driver is enforcing right now. A laptop's own firmware can hold this below the driver maximum.

data.name: TuningViewText921
data.value: NVIDIA POWER UNLOCK (advanced, off by default)

data.name: TuningViewText923
data.value: Order: 1) Resolve VBIOS, 2) Apply MAX, 3) restart Windows, 4) Apply CURRENT. Raises the GPU's power limit above the laptop maker's setting. MAX is stored in the NVIDIA driver's registry and needs a restart; CURRENT is applied live and resets on reboot. More power means more heat. Based on timmyy123's nvidia-power-control and bobshmo's OmenCore-Prophecy, used with their permission.

data.name: TuningViewText934
data.value: Reads the VBIOS power table. Needs nvflash64.exe (nvflashb.exe on RTX 50 cards) next to OmenCore.exe, or use 'From file'. Apply CURRENT does not need it.

data.name: TuningViewText943
data.value: Notes: do not disable PPAB (Dynamic Boost); the adapter limit applies to CPU and GPU together. A graphics driver update can undo the unlock, so check the live values afterwards. The RTX 5050 is untested. If CURRENT will not stick, switch the HP performance mode away and back, then apply again.

data.name: TuningViewText1021
data.value: Whether the confirmed GPU OC profile is currently authorized to reapply when OmenCore starts. Saving or selecting a profile alone never authorizes a startup write.

data.name: TuningViewText1227
data.value: AMD Radeon GPU overclocking is available via AMD Display Library. Adjust clock offsets and power limits below.

data.name: TuningViewText1229
data.value: Manual apply only: AMD offsets are not saved and do not reapply when OmenCore starts. Reapply after every reboot.

data.name: TuningViewText1296
data.value: Restore AMD GPU clocks and power to stock values.

data.name: TuningViewText1302
data.value: Apply the AMD GPU clock and power offsets above. An unstable overclock can cause driver resets or crashes.

data.name: TuningViewText1321
data.value: Your GPU doesn't support clock offset adjustments via NVAPI. Power Limit adjustments still work below.

data.name: TuningViewText1323
data.value: For clock OC, use MSI Afterburner or HP Omen Hub.

data.name: TuningViewText1467
data.value: Apply these GPU settings temporarily so you can check stability. They revert automatically unless you press Keep.

data.name: TuningViewText1474
data.value: Confirm the settings you are currently testing and stop them from reverting.

data.name: TuningViewText1481
data.value: Apply the GPU clock, memory, and power offsets above. An unstable overclock can cause driver resets or crashes.

data.name: TuningViewText1488
data.value: Restore GPU clocks, memory, and power limit to stock values.

data.name: TuningViewText1509
data.value: Your system doesn't support CPU undervolting, power limit control, or GPU overclocking through OmenCore.
